title: West Pakistan Railway Servants Welfare Fund Amendment Ordinance 1984

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Railway Servants Welfare Fund Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1984
WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS WELFARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance to amend the West Pakistan Railway Servants Welfare Fund
Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th July, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the West Pakistan Railway Servants' Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall, unless otherwise specified, be deemed to have taken effect on
the first day of July, 1979.

3. Amendment of section 2, W. P. Ordinance No. XIV of 1969.--In the
said Ordinance, in section 2,-
(a) clause (b)
shall be omitted ;
(b) clause (d) shall
be omitted ; and
(c) for clause
(g) the following shall be substituted, namely :--
"(g)
"Railway servant" means a person employed in connection with the
affairs of, or holding any post in the Pakistan Railways who is under the
administrative control of the Railway Board or the Finance Member of the Board,
and includes-
(i) any person
who holds a post in the Railway Board ; and
(ii) any person
on deputation or foreign service who holds a lien on any post in the Pakistan
Railways and who is regularly subscribing to the Funds.".
